seo-description: How to support Nature regeneration with the Regeneration Credit and earn a contribution certificate.
title: Support Nature regeneration
lead: Anyone can finance the regeneration of ecosystems by holding Regeneration Credit and, when they choose, retiring it for a contribution certificate.
whyBody: Today people have more economic incentive to clear land than to regenerate it. The Regeneration Credit turns verified regeneration into an asset, so regenerators earn an income and supporters can direct funding straight to the people bringing ecosystems back to life.

steps.title: Set up a self-custody wallet
steps.body: Create a MetaMask wallet. It is self-custody, so only you hold the keys, and for now it is the only wallet the apps integrate with.

steps.title: Add the Sintrop network
steps.body: Add the Sintrop Impact Blockchain to MetaMask from the Network page, so your wallet can hold and move Regeneration Credit.

steps.title: Buy Regeneration Credit
steps.body: Buy RC directly from a community member. A peer-to-peer trade gives you a balance of the asset without any intermediary.

steps.title: Hold or use it
steps.body: Keep it as a stake in the system, transfer it freely, or use it as a medium of exchange within the community.

steps.title: Offset for a certificate
steps.body: When you retire (burn) your RC, you receive a contribution certificate: on-chain proof that you financed that amount of verified regeneration.

certificateBody: Every certificate is recorded on-chain and can be checked by anyone on the users portal, where each certificate's QR code resolves. Certified credits are counted separately so the system's certified total is always transparent.
certificateAlt: Example of a supporter's contribution certificate
